root = Stack([sec1, sec2, sec3])
sec1 = Section("Compare plans", [cmp1])
cmp1 = Comparison("", [{name: "Basic", attributes: ["1 vCPU", "1 GB RAM", "20 GB SSD"]}, {name: "Pro", attributes: ["2 vCPU", "4 GB RAM", "80 GB SSD"]}, {name: "Team", attributes: ["4 vCPU", "8 GB RAM", "160 GB SSD"]}])
sec2 = Section("Exact specs", [tbl1])
tbl1 = Table("", ["Plan", "vCPU", "RAM", "SSD", "Price"], [["Basic", "1", "1 GB", "20 GB", "99 kr"], ["Pro", "2", "4 GB", "80 GB", "199 kr"], ["Team", "4", "8 GB", "160 GB", "399 kr"]])
sec3 = Section("Recommendation", [g1])
g1 = Grid([m1, m2])
m1 = Metric("Best value", "Pro", "2 vCPU / 4 GB")
m2 = Metric("Most headroom", "Team", "4 vCPU / 8 GB")
